The named targets cluster around $1,900-2,500, well above the $1,140 base: the gap is mostly the multiple, since the Street is paying ~9x run-rate EPS versus the 6x peak-cycle multiple used here. No broker horizon disclosure was verified, so these calls stay out of the weighted target. All figures are pre-split; the 8-for-1 split makes them 1/8 from Nov 20.
